text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down on the day with minimal momentum in either direction, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than conviction selling. The Fear & Greed index at 29 indicates genuine market apprehension, though the 4-point weekly improvement hints at early stabilization in sentiment. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.6% with modest 24h volume of $50B reflects a market still digesting uncertainty without triggering either panic liquidation or risk-on enthusiasm.
